wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-003 wires the floor and ceiling visplane pool, the per-frame clear operation, the find/check allocator surface, the span cache, and the span-flush walker into a single frozen runtime artifact. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/visplaneRenderer.ts imports createVisplanePool/clearPlanes/findPlane/checkPlane from the read-only src/render/visplanes.ts plus createPlaneSpanCache/renderVisplaneSpans from src/render/visplaneSpans.ts. Overflow on MAXVISPLANES=128 surfaces as RangeError from the read-only allocator helpers (matching vanilla's I_Error fatal path). The pool/cache state is mutable per-frame to match vanilla file-scope globals; the wrapper is frozen at the top level so downstream subsystems cannot replace the references.
publicSurface: VisplaneRenderer interface (check, clear, find, pool, renderSpans, spanCache)
